Hero.name: Alessia
Hero.tagline: I work on posture, recovery and strength with a method built on the person, not on the programme.

About.heading: About
About.intro: I'm a kinesiologist with a degree in Movement Sciences. I work with people who want to move without pain again, recover after an injury, or build strength intelligently.
About.credentials: Degree in Movement Sciences · registered kinesiologist · continued training in postural rehabilitation and functional strength.
About.method: The first session is always an assessment: posture, mobility, habits. Then I build the programme, and update it as we work together.

Services.heading: What I do
Services.lead: Four ways to work together. Each starts from the same place: an assessment.
